Play Lou's Lagoon on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch: https://ninten.do/6000auOqY

With your trusty seaplane at the ready, take off on a tropical adventure across the Limbo archipelago in search of your uncle Lou! Collect resources, help rebuild a community, and unravel the mystery of your uncle’s disappearance.
